title: Strong monoidal cochain section equivalence with its fixed comparison
statement: Let Λ be a commutative condensed ring and assume HasDerivedCategory for section modules over every scheme. For every scheme T, the functor of the cochain equivalence induced termwise by equivalence Λ T admits a strong monoidal structure for the canonical signed cochain tensors. Its oplax tensorator on P,Q is exactly (cochainTensorComparison Λ T P Q).hom, for all unbounded internal cochain complexes P,Q.

source.place: Tags 06YU, 07A4 and 0FPT; signed-total extension of the ordinary section tensor comparison

proof.text: Use the proved canonical ordinary section monoidal data. Its oplax tensorator agrees with ordinaryTensorComparison by the fixed pure-tensor normalization. Apply the standard strong monoidal extension of an additive monoidal equivalence to cochain complexes. The extension tensorator is mapBifunctorComparison of the ordinary oplax natural transformation. Equality of its ordinary components with the canonical curried comparison gives equality of the two natural transformations. sectionTotalComparison_eq identifies this signed total comparison with cochainTensorComparison. No boundedness or nonzero hypothesis is used.

from.place: The first proof step: the fixed cochain section equivalence is strong monoidal

lean.statement:
theorem section_cochain_monoidal_data (T : Scheme.{u}) :
    ∃ m : ((equivalence Λ T).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).functor.Monoidal,
      letI := m
      ∀ P Q : CochainComplex (internalModules Λ T) ℤ,
        Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ
            ((equivalence Λ T).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).functor P Q =
          (cochainTensorComparison Λ T P Q).hom
